decisions.decision: The Committee determined the Select Board should remain the enforcing authority for Chapter 232 Unregistered Vehicles, rather than delegating enforcement to the Building Commissioner.
decisions.quote: the committee determined the select board should remain the enforcing authority since a vote delegating this authority could be undone.

decisions.decision: The Committee agreed to reach out to enforcing authorities to ask about the current fines.
decisions.quote: the committee agreed to reach out to enforcing authorities to ask.

decisions.decision: Conditionally, if all enforcing authorities can designate authority, the term 'or designated agent' is to be removed from the DPW Director provision.
decisions.quote: committee agreed the term "or designated agent " should be removed.

decisions.decision: No update to the Chapter 12 Article II building committee section is needed for the Municipal Building Design Committee.
decisions.quote: agreed that no update to this section needed to be made to reflect this .

decisions.decision: Ms. Duffy will review the membership sections (including whether living in Town is required to serve) and draft standardized language for the next meeting.
decisions.quote: ms. duffy will review these sections and draft standardized language to review next meeting .

decisions.decision: The Committee will review approximately the first 20 pages of Part II: General Legislation at the next meeting.
decisions.quote: the committee decide d to review approximately the first 20 pages of part ii: general legislation during the next meeting.

decisions.decision: The next meeting is set for October 30 at 6:45 pm.
decisions.quote: the committee decided to meet on october 30 th at 6:45 pm.
